description: Weather forecasts from the Rapid Refresh Forecast System (RRFS) operated by NOAA NWS NCEP.
attribution: NOAA NWS NCEP RRFS data processed by dynamical.org from NOAA Open Data Dissemination archives.
description_summary:
This dataset is an archive of past and present RRFS forecasts, optimized for spatial (map) access patterns. Forecasts are identified by an initialization time (`init_time`) denoting the start time of the model run, and step forward hourly along the `lead_time` dimension out to 18 hours. A new forecast is initialized every 3 hours.

This dataset uses the native RRFS Lambert Conformal Conic projection, with spatial indexing along the `x` and `y` dimensions. The example notebook shows how to use the embedded spatial reference to select geographic areas of interest.

Variables on pressure levels, fixed heights above mean sea level and soil depths live in the `pressure_level`, `height_above_mean_sea_level` and `depth_below_ground` groups.

Note: `dynamical-catalog>=0.8.0` with `gribberish>=1.8.1` (or `zarr>=3.2 icechunk>=2.0 gribberish>=1.8.1`) is required.
description_details:
### Source

The source grib files this archive is constructed from are provided by [NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD)](https://www.noaa.gov/information-technology/open-data-dissemination) and accessed from the [AWS Open Data Registry](https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-rrfs/).

### Storage

Storage for this dataset is generously provided by [AWS Open Data](https://aws.amazon.com/opendata/).

### Chunks

This dataset is stored in [Zarr](https://zarr.dev/) format, which splits each variable into a grid of **chunks** — the smallest unit read from storage. When possible, aligning your reads with this dataset's chunk grid can significantly improve data access speed.

The element count and coordinate span of this dataset:

| dimension | chunk |
|---|---|
| init_time | 1 (3 hours) |
| lead_time | 1 (1 hour) |
| y | 1059 (3177 km) |
| x | 1799 (5397 km) |
| **uncompressed** | 14.5 MiB |

### Validation report

Review the [validation report](https://dynamical.org/catalog/noaa-rrfs-forecast-18-hour-virtual/validation/) for variable availability, missing data, known quirks, fill values, value distributions, and sample plots.
description_model: The Rapid Refresh Forecast System (RRFS) is a National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) convection-allowing weather forecast model with a 3 km grid, built on the Unified Forecast System. It is planned to replace several of NOAA's current regional models, including the HRRR. RRFS is pre-operational and under development, so expect some changes to model output.

variants.label: dynamical-catalog
variants.code:
import dynamical_catalog  # dynamical-catalog>=0.8.0

ds = dynamical_catalog.open("noaa-rrfs-forecast-18-hour-virtual", chunks=None)
ds["temperature_2m"].sel(init_time="2026-09-16T12", lead_time="12h")

# Variables with a vertical dimension live in the pressure_level,
# height_above_mean_sea_level and depth_below_ground groups
ds_pressure = dynamical_catalog.open("noaa-rrfs-forecast-18-hour-virtual", group="pressure_level", chunks=None)

ds_pressure["temperature"].sel(init_time="2026-09-16T12", lead_time="12h", pressure_level=500)

variants.label: pystac
variants.code:
import icechunk
import pystac
import xarray as xr

catalog = pystac.Catalog.from_file("https://stac-staging.dynamical.org/catalog.json")
collection = catalog.get_child("noaa-rrfs-forecast-18-hour-virtual")
asset = collection.assets["icechunk-https"]

authorize = icechunk.containers_credentials({"s3://noaa-rrfs-ops-pds/": icechunk.s3_anonymous_credentials()})
repo = icechunk.Repository.open(
    icechunk.http_storage(asset.href),
    authorize_virtual_chunk_access=authorize,
)
session = repo.readonly_session("main")

ds = xr.open_zarr(session.store, chunks=None)
ds["temperature_2m"].sel(init_time="2026-09-16T12", lead_time="12h")

# Variables with a vertical dimension live in the pressure_level,
# height_above_mean_sea_level and depth_below_ground groups
ds_pressure = xr.open_zarr(session.store, group="pressure_level", chunks=None)

ds_pressure["temperature"].sel(init_time="2026-09-16T12", lead_time="12h", pressure_level=500)

height_above_mean_sea_level/wind_v.comment: NaN where this height is below the terrain. Velocity along the model grid's y dimension, not northward velocity.

pressure_level/wind_u.comment: Velocity along the model grid's x dimension, not eastward velocity.
